name: Pati

queries.query: Pati Indonesia official cadastral parcel map geoportal API; official land parcel map Pati Regency
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the ATR/BPN ATLAS national geospatial portal and the Pati local LokaGeo portal. ATLAS advertises land-parcel map data, but the anonymous landing page showed zero published catalog items and a login control. LokaGeo advertises a Pati WebGIS, but its current WebGIS source code explicitly labels polygon content as simulated data and uses OpenStreetMap only; no cadastral service was exposed.

queries.result: First-party Indonesian-language discovery again identified ATR/BPN ATLAS as the national land-spatial portal and LokaGeo Kabupaten Pati as a local geospatial portal. The accessible ATLAS page did not expose an anonymous parcel layer or feature response; the local WebGIS page contains simulated demo polygons rather than cadastral data. No local parcel endpoint was qualified.
